notes: New in 0.23: Bring in old emails opens the .ost files that Outlook 2013 and later keep, and Save a copy can make an Outlook data file (.pst), so an old .ost becomes a .pst that Outlook opens. Free, with no limit on how many emails. Help can show you where a button is, with a ring round it, and has 41 more pages and a one-page guide to print for each part. Albums can make a photo better (always as a copy), print photos, make copies for a photo frame and share an album with one link from your own OneDrive. Bring in old emails takes Outlook .msg files too. Signed by 365 Techies Ltd.
